error.not-loaded: The on-device model is not loaded.

workspace.title: On-device workspace
workspace.description: Files are parsed, split into chunks and indexed with BM25 in a background worker on this device, and removed when you reload the page. Nothing is uploaded or synced; only when the cloud assistant or your own server writes an answer are the matching excerpts sent along with the question. Answers cite them as [Doc: file, Chunk: n].

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics & benchmark
diagnostics.subtitle: WebGPU adapter properties and a measured inference benchmark of the on-device model.
diagnostics.benchmark_description: A warm-up request, then a fixed prompt of about 64 tokens that generates exactly 128 tokens on the on-device model. Time to first token and decode throughput are measured on that run.
